description: Coverage gate thresholds for PicoCompute launch reviews. Line coverage gates; region coverage is warn-only. See docs/security/coverage-threshold.md.
scope: crates/*/src/** filtered from llvm-cov JSON (workspace default members, eBPF crates excluded via workspace exclude). Workspace and per-crate floors all use this filtered scope; unfiltered llvm-cov totals are recorded informationally in gate.json.
runner: ubuntu-latest x86_64 only. Arch-gated or OS-gated code covered on another arch reads as uncovered here; see coverage threshold doc limitations.

warn_only.note: Region coverage approximates branch coverage and is reported but never blocks. Tighten to a blocking gate only after three consecutive green CI runs with variance under 2 points.

calibration: Starter floors are unmeasured. If the first main runs fail, run once with COVERAGE_WARN_ONLY=1 to observe real values, then adjust floors to observed values with a dated entry plus Security owner approval. Never silently keep a red gate red.
ratchet: Thresholds are floors, not targets. Raise a floor only after the new floor holds for three consecutive main runs. Never lower a floor without Security owner approval and a dated entry in docs/security/coverage-threshold.md.
